name: mcp-mechanic
subtitle: Set up and fix MCP servers without exposing secrets
title: MCP Mechanic
installMethods: zip upload in Claude apps (Settings > Capabilities > Skills)

permissions.files: Reads its own reference files. Proposes config edits; writes only if the agent's own permissions allow and the user agrees.
permissions.shell: Suggests commands such as claude mcp add and claude mcp list. Bundles no scripts.
permissions.mcp: Helps configure MCP servers; adds none itself.

acknowledgedFindings.reason: Names the MCP config file paths of Cursor and Claude Desktop because configuring them is the skill's purpose. It tells the user where to edit; it does not change permissions, hooks or security settings.
